Senses.Explanation: The fourth realm: where thing and principle merging was still a halfway house, every single thing now enters and holds every other thing. Zhenjing Kewen's own six verses on the three realm-views open with the freedom refrain — pig's head in hand, precepts on the lips, brothel left, wine debt unpaid, the bag opened at the crossroads; Miyun Yuanwu raises the same couplet in his hall and then stamps it with his staff: thing with thing nothing obstructed, as-you-wish and free, whatever the hand picks up runs through the whole realm-field; Feiyin Tongrong writes back to a fellow master that cutting off mountains and rivers at one stroke is still only the principle-realm — thing with thing means one range entering numberless ranges with neither face broken; Huanyou Zhengchuan on the birthday day runs the four realms to their end and says they gather up world and world-transcending truth entire. Zhongfeng Mingben climbs his ladder of no-obstruction from the unobstructed heart through every rung until copying the Garland and not copying it are both unobstructed; Tianru Weize tells an assembly the Garland teachers' four realms, the Pure Land gates, and the founding teacher's one line all point at the same one truth; Tianran Hanshi warns that pinning the realms down neatly would only qualify a man to be a lecturer's assistant and lose the school's eye; and Wuyi Yuanlai, answering a letter on where the fourth realm belongs, turns the boundary question back on its asker — if it is the perfect teaching, how could it fail to hold thing with thing?
